headline: Acuity Posts Strong Q3 Results, Joins BlackBerry, MillerKnoll, Qualcomm And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Thursday
summary: Dow Jones index gained 200 points; Acuity Inc (NYSE: AYI) reported better-than-expected financial results, shares rose 17.1%; other big stocks also gained.

headline: RBC Capital Maintains Sector Perform on Qualcomm, Raises Price Target to $250

summary: Qualcomm (NASDAQ:QCOM) has outperformed the market over the past 10 years by 1.09% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 14.6%. Currently, Qualcomm has a market capitalization of $220.49 billion.
